answer: Copper Thread Ledger: each identity must carry a continuous signed transaction thread rooted in a distinct physical device whose copper wiring emits a measurable RF fingerprint; a river of challenge probes verifies the same hardware responds across time. Enforcement: one thread per fingerprint, and duplicate fingerprints collapse to a single identity. An attacker faking N sybils must acquire and maintain N distinct physical devices, paying hardware plus ongoing probe-response upkeep per identity.
